summary_md: **Manfriday ([@Manfridayy](https://x.com/Manfridayy/status/2116177023010013682))** shares **switch**, a framework for decision-model harnesses where your program offers a short list of next steps and the model picks one at a time until it can answer ([osolmaz/switch](https://github.com/osolmaz/switch)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - osolmaz/switch: A framework for building decision-model harnesses for any kind of task. Your program offers the model a short list of next steps, and the model picks one at a time until it can answer.
